title: Castelion hero
description: A three-window-tall hero over a full-window film that stays pinned while you scroll: a darkened dusk wash until a video fills it. Further down, a huge bold cream mission title and a bold lead slide up line by line out of masks, then a one-line motto. Cream venetian-blind stripes rise from the bottom edge, thickening and spreading as you scroll until they close over the film and hand over to the cream page.
notes: 300svh tall: the film is pinned for the first two windows, the text scrolls over it
the blinds use the page background token, so they close onto whatever colour the next section has
made to sit under castelion-header (the first window shows only the film and the header)
scroll-driven CSS (view timeline); without support, or with reduced motion, the blinds stay as hairlines and the text shows in place
